Which sheet to use: Dojo 450, Blind/NeetCode, Striver, company lists

The famous problem lists overlap far more than their sizes suggest. This page measures the overlap, explains how the Dojo Curated 450 and its tiers A/B/C are computed from all of them plus company frequency and recent reports, and shows how to filter by company, frequency and time window in the last weeks before a loop.
